_comment: MEN12: output quality of libr3's native gfx11 attention (x-bigcherry kernels.attn-native, production default on) on Qwen3.8-27B MXFP4 served by the two XTX (tp 2, exact wire) - the path where the XTX run the whole model, which the Flash-Next helper layout does not exercise. Each arm is its own native YAML (27b-native-kld/*.yaml, written by arm_yaml.py from engines/radiance/configs/qwen27b-2xtx.yaml with tp-wire exact, max-num-seqs 1 and the kernels table); regenerate one with: python3 tools/lab/radiance/arm_yaml.py --base engines/radiance/configs/qwen27b-2xtx.yaml --out tools/lab/radiance/27b-native-kld/ARM.yaml --set models.qwen27b.tp-wire=exact --set models.qwen27b.max-num-seqs=1 --set x-bigcherry.kernels.attn-native=BOOL --set x-bigcherry.kernels.moe-native=false. Control arm 'compat' has attn-native and moe-native false; arm 'attn-native' turns the attention native on. bc-serve quality scores each arm against a stored reference (quality.reference_dir and reference_metadata: pin, layout, recorded_on; set KLD_REF_DIR); it does not record one, so record the reference first on a different layout than the control, or the control reproduces it exactly (KL 0, top-1 100%) and the gate reads the native arm as a top-1 drop. Reading on radiance 1.7.0 (2026-10-17, recorded then with the compat run): attn-native KLD 0.0040, median 0.0015, P99 0.031, top-1 96.6%, PPL 7.358 vs 7.368; on 1.3.0 KLD 0.0035 / top-1 96.8%. Set BC_MODEL_ROOT, RAD_BIN and KLD_REF_DIR before use. Not used by tests.
